feeding_claim.verbatim: Our beef and lamb are 100% grass-fed and grass-finished. No grain. Ever.

pickup_locations: Neighborhood drop sites and flex pickup sites in the Phoenix and Tucson areas (30+ locations, shown by zip code at checkout)

resold_note: Also distributes raw milk from Desert Oasis Family Farm, a separate dairy in Eloy, AZ.
notes: Farm in the Sulphur Springs Valley; address and phone from the site. Pork and poultry are rotated on pasture and fed non-GMO grain milled on the farm (sorghum, triticale, oats), so they are pastured rather than grass-fed. Eggs are sold (pickup only) but the site does not say who raises the laying hens, so eggs left out of species; verifier may confirm. UPS home delivery of frozen meat ships every other Tuesday, $150 minimum, free over $175; the site names no shipping area, only that transit depends on distance from the Arizona farm, so ships_to left empty. Farm pickup in Cochise Mon to Sat 8 to 6. No bulk shares or farmers markets mentioned. Store prices require an account. Thanksgiving turkey pre-orders open as of 2026-11-07.
